summary: Advises checking existing solutions (builtin modules, the package collection index, Galaxy, Automation Hub) before writing new content, and improving existing collections rather than duplicating them.
questions: Where should I look before writing a new Ansible module?
Should I improve an existing collection instead of making my own?

answer_card.title: Check for existing solutions first
answer_card.answer_md:
Before building, search:
- `ansible.builtin` modules and plugins
- The Ansible package collection index
- Ansible Galaxy
- Automation Hub (with an AAP subscription)

If something is close, improve it (each collection says where to file issues). Create your own only if nothing fits.
